extension.summary: Live ships on a Blue Marble map of the water you choose
extension.description: Turns an idle TV into a live shipping map. Pick a bounding box anywhere on the water and the add-on subscribes to the public AIS stream for that box, then draws every ship it hears on a high-resolution NASA Blue Marble image of the same area. Vessels are coloured by type and turned to their course; the panel on the right lists the ships currently in the box with their type, flag, speed, length and destination, and crossfades through photographs of them from Wikimedia Commons. The chosen area is sent to aisstream.io as the subscription box, and the edges of the box are padded only for the map so the image keeps its true proportions. A free API key from aisstream.io is required and is stored in the add-on settings. Ships, their details and their photos are cached in a small database in the add-on profile, so a vessel that stays in the area is not looked up again and a restart shows the last known positions while the stream reconnects. Any key, click or mouse move exits straight away.
extension.disclaimer: AIS positions are supplied by aisstream.io and are subject to its terms; the add-on sends your API key and the bounding box to that service. The base map is NASA Blue Marble imagery rendered on demand by NASA EOSDIS GIBS and is in the public domain. Ship details and photographs are fetched from Wikidata and Wikimedia Commons; photographs remain under their own licences and are not redistributed with this add-on. The add-on is not affiliated with aisstream.io, NASA, Wikidata or Wikimedia. Add-on code: MIT.
